pixel_description: Photorealistic side view of rover on dirt, left to right: dark soil pile with dust cloud, front-most spiked disk half-buried digging (front digging drum) connected by longitudinal arm to middle spiked wheel axle, middle spiked grouser wheel under front of open box chassis, rear spiked grouser wheel under rear of chassis, central rectangular chassis frame open on side showing left box (battery) and right beige box (computer) with black wiring, tall vertical telescoping mast mounted on front top of chassis rising about 2x chassis height with camera pointing left, sensor box, dome, antenna and loop cable on top head, rear lift assembly mounted on rear top of chassis rising up-back holding large tilted trapezoidal bucket (hopper) pouring continuous dark soil stream into separate open rectangular bin behind rover. Critical part Rear high-lift mast (lift): drawn as 4 long elements - two hydraulic cylinders and two structural flat arms in paired 4-bar/scissor arrangement, base pivoted with pins on rear of chassis, top pivoted with pins to sides of hopper, extended diagonally up-back to hold hopper high behind rear axle with clear overhang over bin lip in dumping pose.

regions.observed: Leader arrow ends on empty dust cloud left/above drum, not on drum metal
regions.expected: Leader for Front Digging Drum ends on front spiked drum metal

comparison_with_previous: No previous render provided for comparison; this is first evaluation.

deviations.why: Part is present and correctly connected via arm to chassis; segmenter miss due to dust occlusion and similarity to wheels. No impact on working principle.

deviations.why: Overcount because spiked digging drum looks like spiked wheel. Actual grouser wheels present (middle and rear) correctly mounted under chassis. Does not change drive function.

deviations.why: Same overcount as front wheel. Rear wheel present under rear chassis, correct size and spiked. Does not change flotation or tip geometry.

deviations.why: Critical part present with correct base-on-chassis and top-on-hopper pivots and deployed overhang. Segmenter miss due to thin arms. Geometry correct so no matter.

s1_differences: Geometry matches sketch: drum digging front, 2 grouser wheels, chassis with pack/compute, tall front mast with sensors, rear mast raised with hopper dumping into bin with overhang. Same connections and directions. Only mismatch is depiction: Front Digging Drum callout leader misses drum and ends in air.
s2_feedback: No design flaw visible in this faithful geometry: rear lift base sits on chassis rear with load path to rear wheels, hopper clears bin lip with overhang and pours without hitting lift, front mast clears drum arm, wheels maintain ground contact with no tipping shown.
notes: Photorealistic side view otherwise matches sketch geometry. Only depiction fault is Front Digging Drum leader missing metal. All segmenter 'not found' are segmenter misses, not absent parts.
